text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The upcoming Arima Kinen is the talk of the town, everyone being excited to see Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross face off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek, a quick-thinking runner with high endurance who's making quite a name for herself, is also slated to run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One feels that it's fate she'll be able to run in the same race as such great rivals, and that they're destined to make it a festival to remember.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though she's eager to run against these incredible Umamusume in her upcoming senior year, there's another race she must conquer first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We begin making final preparations for the Tokyo Daishoten, which she plans to win so she can start her senior year at the top of the regionals.
